sdk_integration_plan.scope_rule: All SDK-eligible child L3 are delivered with their public adapter; host-internal/governance work records an explicit reason instead of exposing private state.

baseline.qualification: Planning baseline only; source presence and runtime metadata are not new execution evidence.

sdk_integration_plan.owner_specific_task: Ring-family typed builders theo từng L3; không dùng private UI algorithm để tạo geometry.
tasks: Audit exact L3 source and standalone evidence; reuse the existing Rust service where present. Do not infer completion from planning metadata.

For an SDK-eligible feature, implement public DTO/wrapper/capability and host dispatch in the same owner delivery as the application service; existing completed core code receives an explicit SDK retrofit task here.
Preserve units, coordinate spaces, permissions, revision/identity, budgets, cancellation and host-owned atomic transaction/Undo semantics.
Verify an external plugin built from the public SDK, geometry/metadata parity, error/Cancel/Undo/Redo and persistence where relevant; prove each advertised native target separately.
Update this owner, its affected L3 traceability/runtime evidence, API inventory/example and live ledger; keep unverified SDK scope open without erasing prior core evidence.
sdk_integration_plan.completion_rule: For SDK-eligible scope, the owner delivery includes the public contract, host route, shared service and external plugin evidence. Host-internal exceptions require a documented ownership reason. Existing business/manual gates remain in force.
sdk_integration_plan.target_evidence_policy: Windows and macOS execution are recorded separately; shared source or a package target entry does not prove macOS runtime.

runtime_implementation.target: Standalone Rust OM9; Windows x64; CARGO_TARGET_DIR=L:/om9-target; -j 2
runtime_implementation.scope: Eternity/Signet/Raised/Award ring builders: portable sections previewed as mesh, committed as an OCCT B-Rep sewn from the same sections, stone frames, viewport handles, preset roundtrip, associative resize and the shared closed/volume gate
runtime_implementation.notes: Ring body là một surface of revolution; preview là mesh portable, body commit là B-Rep OCCT sew từ đúng các section qua RingFamilyBrepProducer, cả hai qua cổng chung inspect_measures/inspect_geometry nên không có body hở. Viewport handle sửa cùng field với panel (adjust_field). Gem solids ngoài scope (frames only). Builtin style vocabulary vẫn là width/height; ring-preset vocabulary cần approval.
remaining: The B-Rep is a closed solid of planar triangles sewn from the sampled sections (chord error about 5 um at 96 segments), not a NURBS surface; a later surface rebuild must pass the same inspect_geometry gate.
Gem solids are out of scope: the Eternity builder publishes placement frames only (M05 gem integration).
The builtin style vocabulary still speaks rail-profile width/height; a ring-preset vocabulary (stone count, top pad) is a business-rule change that needs approval.
Handles cover diameter, width, wall and one kind-specific grip (stone, ridge or shoulder); stone count and shoulder taper have no grip because they are not a single silhouette distance.
clippy runs with `-A clippy::type_complexity` because one concurrent session's in-flight file (crates/om9-core/src/curve_ops.rs:600) trips that lint; no ring-family file needs the allow.
macOS runtime is unverified; the evidence is Windows x64 only.
